info.title: Smart Home Solutions private Home Assistant API
info.description: Private device client API. Supabase /functions/v1 is a gateway path and is not this contract version.

post.description: Report current HA runtime readiness or a requested replan failure, and read status back. The response is the same discovery document the GET returns.

200.description: Accepted telemetry and optional generated plan

ApiSuccess.description: Clients declaring X-SHS-API-Version: 1 receive payloads once, inside data. Top-level data aliases remain for undeclared readers during the documented reader-first rollout.

pending_replan_request_id.description: A replan the household has asked for and not yet been given. The device answers it by pushing a snapshot to /energy-optimisation-ingest carrying this id.

runtime_received.description: True only when this request stored the runtime report; false for ignored reports, null for other status requests.

replan_request_id.description: The pending_replan_request_id this push answers. Only meaningful with a snapshot, because only a generated plan can complete a request.

decision_diagnostics_version.description: Independent version of additive, non-executable decision evidence. Version 2 adds the exact derived home-battery curve; absent on plans issued before marginal-value-planner-v11.

stop_temperature_c.description: Website Stop at temperature. Controllers may enable scheduled heating only below this measured water temperature; null means no explicit zero-value endpoint is configured.

shadow_import_sek_per_kwh.description: Exact unrounded all-in import value used for each horizon quarter; supplying it as the fourth planner argument bypasses price-shape estimation for deterministic replay.

planning_choice_at.description: Actual website decision; null means never reviewed. Inventory pushes do not change it.

error.description: Why this device could not build a snapshot to plan from, in the household's own terms.

items.description: Journalled native attempts, including request identity, transport state and possible physical effects.
